limits: UI plugin interface supplies no capability isolation or execution authority contract.

signature: release world2-live-network-pets-windows/0.1.0; windows-x64 artifact 718336 bytes, SHA-256 b2107825ff8d582fb0f23a9f099c943f2cf036bdf0f125fd0c589e57b8d194d7
semantics: Frozen binary exists and its measured bytes/hash match the checked-in release manifest.
limits: Artifact hash was checked; binary was not executed. This is a distinct Windows app, not a Windows Rhea-play or Omnia client.

signature: Git repository; unborn HEAD; tracked_files=[]; working_files=[]; entries_excluding_git=[]
semantics: This actual app-mapped workspace is an empty Git container, not an inspected implementation module.
limits: Scope is the exact directory at inventory time; other local projects and remote repositories may implement related concepts.

signature: world_input_frame_t{sequence:u64,timestamp_ms:u64,strength_q16:u16,variability_q16:u16,novelty_q16:u16,freshness_ms:u32,valid:u8,source:u8}
semantics: Bounded network-derived feature input has explicit simulated/replay/live/stale provenance enum.
limits: Telemetry feature source is not storage data, model state, RF imaging or a filesystem observation acknowledgment.

signature: void world_engine_step(world_engine_t*,const world_config_t*,const world_input_frame_t*,world_pose_frame_t*)
semantics: C engine boundary transforms input/config plus explicit engine state into pose output.
limits: No current execution or determinism test was run.

signature: world_pose_frame_t includes frame_hash:u64,root_y_um:i32,joint_mdeg:i32[9],source,valid,behavior; world_pose_to_json(pose,buffer,capacity)->int
semantics: Integer pose frame is an engine-to-renderer wire boundary with separate provenance and freshness.
limits: frame_hash:u64 is a distinct domain from SHA-256 object IDs and must not be normalized to cryptographic CAS identity.

signature: InputFrame valid:bool,source:Source; PoseFrame frame_hash:u64,joint_mdeg:[i32;JOINT_COUNT]; Engine.step(&mut self,&Config,InputFrame)->PoseFrame
semantics: Rust implementation presents analogous domain types to the C kernel with typed bool/enums.
limits: Shape similarity is not byte layout/FFI equivalence; C and Rust parity is a historical documented claim unless rerun.
README reports historical C/Rust parity but leaves Lens replay and live-WLAN-to-Lens runtime gates pending; no current execution here.

signature: mockLocalFiles: array<{id,name,size,category,path,modified,stubbed,targetVault}>; GET /api/files
semantics: The file list is initialized in process memory and returned directly. Status totals derive from that same array, while free disk and Rust metrics are queried independently.
limits: UI file state is not a materialized projection of either SQLite database.

signature: XcodeGen RheaPlay: application, platform macOS 14.0; import SwiftUI, Pow, RheaKit
semantics: The observed Rhea-play entrypoint is a macOS operations UI; its panes consume RheaKit state and HTTP APIs.
limits: No build or native execution performed; this target declaration supplies no Windows or iOS RheaPlay target.
Legacy panes include NDI, which remains outside Omnia desktop v1 scope.

signature: library RheaKit; platforms iOS 17, macOS 14; dependencies GRDB, Collections, KeychainAccess, MarkdownUI, Starscream, Pow
semantics: Shared Swift UI/client package declares storage, auth, WebSocket and rendering libraries.
limits: Dependency declarations do not establish their runtime use or successful resolution.

signature: Codable, Identifiable; name/alive/pace/mode/T_day/dollar_day/floor_gap required; lease_token:Int?, lease_expired:Bool?, hard_fail:Bool?
semantics: Agent operational/budget view model, keyed by name. Missing lease/failure fields are exposed through accessors defaulting to 0/false.
limits: Optional absent safety state is not proof of non-expiration or absence of a hard failure.

signature: get(_ path:String, auth:Bool=false) async throws -> Data; post(_ path:String, body:Encodable, auth:Bool=true) async throws -> Data; native HealthSnapshot requires status/providers_available/providers_total/total_models/execution_profile/analyzer_version/profile_mode
semantics: Shared HTTP transport prefers AuthManager JWT, otherwise sends API key; missing stored key defaults to literal development fallback.
limits: No network calls made. Client fallback does not prove server accepts it; fallback is not conditioned on a debug compilation branch here.

signature: GET /cc/history,/cc/radio,/cc/office,/aletheia/proofs -> [[String:Any]]
semantics: These history/evidence endpoints are weakly typed dictionaries; missing expected array keys become empty arrays.
limits: Comments call the backend SQL-backed/immutable, but this client cannot prove storage durability, immutability or verdict authority.

signature: POST /supervisor/spawn {agent,prompt?}; POST /supervisor/kill/{sessionId} {confirm:true}; POST /supervisor/input/{sessionId} {text}
semantics: UI client includes process-affecting command endpoints beyond monitoring.
limits: Availability here is client surface evidence only; server authorization and actual process mutation were not tested.

signature: @MainActor ObservableObject; shared; db:DatabaseQueue?; @Published agents,health,connectionAlive,proofCount
semantics: UI store maintains polled remote state and declares cached_proofs/cached_history local SQLite tables.
limits: Observed schema creation is not evidence of a functioning offline synchronization path.

signature: startPolling(interval:TimeInterval=5); refreshCore() async; refreshHistory(limit:Int=50) async -> [[String:Any]]
semantics: Agent fetch success controls connectionAlive; health and proof reads can fail silently; history errors return empty arrays.
limits: Empty, unavailable and stale are conflated by some return paths; no runtime polling test performed.

signature: default API simulator localhost:8400, otherwise configured production host; migrateStaleDefaults()
semantics: Non-simulator initialization replaces certain localhost/private-network stored URLs with the production URL.
limits: A deliberate local endpoint can be rewritten; source comment about universal reachability is not verified.
Atlas independently defaults to localhost:8000 via environment configuration; native simulator uses localhost:8400.

signature: fetch() async reads /cc/history?limit=50 through URLSession.shared with development fallback header
semantics: A direct history fetch bypasses the shared RheaAPI transport/auth logic, contradicting the claimed one-client boundary.
limits: Bounded counterexample; not an exhaustive network-call inventory.
